from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

# In obs_0016, where are the bottom contact points of each of the 4 table legs?
arr16 = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0016.png"))
# legs:
legs = (arr16[:, :, 0] > 70) & (arr16[:, :, 0] < 120) & (arr16[:, :, 1] > 30) & (arr16[:, :, 1] < 70) & (arr16[:, :, 2] < 30) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] > 100)
y16, x16 = np.where(legs)

# Let group legs by x:
# Front-left leg, back-left leg, front-right leg, back-right leg
for y in range(350, 480, 10):
    xs = x16[y16 == y]
    if len(xs) > 0:
        print(f"y={y}: xs = {np.unique(xs)}")
'
